sections.markdown:
## Turning, parking, speed and railroad crossings

FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A01
The handbook's Super Speeder threshold is a speeding conviction at 75 miles per hour or more on a two-lane road, or at 85 miles per hour or more on any Georgia road. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A01
The handbook describes a separate 200-dollar state Super Speeder charge in addition to local fines. Late payment results in license suspension and an additional 50-dollar reinstatement charge. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A01
Unless a different limit is posted, the handbook's general maximum in an urban or residential district is 30 miles per hour. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A01
For an unpaved county road, the handbook's default maximum is 35 miles per hour unless posted otherwise. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A01
The handbook's general rural-interstate maximum is 70 miles per hour, subject to the posted limit. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R06 | anchor: A01
On an urban interstate or a multilane divided highway, the handbook gives a general maximum of 65 miles per hour unless another limit is posted. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R07 | anchor: A01
For other areas, the handbook's general maximum is 55 miles per hour unless posted otherwise. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R08 | anchor: A01
Road authorities can adjust limits for local conditions temporarily or permanently. Watch signs, including temporary school or construction-zone limits, and reduce speed before entering the zone. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R09 | anchor: A01
Do not drive so slowly that normal, reasonable traffic is impeded, except when the lower speed is needed to operate safely. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R10 | anchor: A01
Where several lanes carry traffic in the same direction, slower traffic should stay right except to pass or turn left. Do not remain in the passing lane while a faster vehicle overtakes from behind. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R11 | anchor: A01
Some highways have posted minimum speeds. If unable to meet the minimum, choose another route. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R12 | anchor: A01
At a railroad crossing, stop between 15 and 50 feet from the closest rail when warning lights flash, a gate is down, a flagger signals a stop, a posted stop sign requires it, or an approaching train presents an immediate hazard. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R13 | anchor: A01
Never drive around, under or through a lowered railroad gate. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R14 | anchor: A01
After stopping for a train, wait until every track is clear, warning lights have stopped, gates are raised and crossing is safe. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R15 | anchor: A01
Approach tracks cautiously, prepare to stop, look and listen in both directions, then check again before crossing. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R16 | anchor: A01
Do not enter a railroad crossing without enough room to drive completely through it without stopping. Once safely committed, keep moving across the tracks. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

FACT_ID: sec05-R17 | anchor: A01
If the vehicle stalls on tracks, leave it immediately and move away. Find the emergency-notification sign and call for help, explaining that a vehicle is on the tracks. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=22]

Misconceptions: A parking diagram is not permission to stop where parking is prohibited; a passing-lane speed does not cancel the duty to move right when required.
Mnemonic: Space to stop, room to see, room to clear.
Glossary: A crossover connects the separated sides of a divided road; a minimum-speed sign states the lowest permitted travel speed under its conditions.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Speed statutes, fines, reinstatement charges and administrative enforcement retain current-law verification debt.
